author: ArvaNet
description: Monitor taken usernames and get alerted the moment they free up or drop, check handle and domain availability across the major social platforms and TLDs, and screen names for trademark conflicts.
name: NameSniper

resources.name: platforms
resources.description: Supported social media platforms and domain TLDs

tools.name: namesniper_check
tools.description: All-in-one brand name check: domain availability across TLDs, username availability across the major social platforms, an optional 0-100 brand score, and USPTO trademark screening. Returns JSON with per-TLD and per-platform results (each with an availability verdict and 0-1 confidence), availability summaries, brandScore, and trademark risk. Use namesniper_check_domains or namesniper_check_social instead when only one dimension is needed. Free without an API key (rate-limited; trademark is skipped and Instagram/TikTok/X return best-effort HTTP confidence); a paid key unlocks verified accuracy on those platforms plus trademark screening.

platforms.description: Social platforms to check (default: all supported platforms)

trademark.description: Include trademark screening via USPTO — requires an API key; ignored for unauthenticated callers (default: true when authenticated)

tools.name: namesniper_check_domains
tools.description: Check whether a domain name is registered across multiple TLDs using DNS lookups with a registry-data fallback. Returns JSON with per-TLD results (available true/false with a 0-1 confidence score) and an available/taken summary. Faster and narrower than namesniper_check when social handles are not needed. Free, rate-limited.

name.description: The domain name to check (without TLD)

tools.name: namesniper_check_social
tools.description: Check username availability across the major social platforms concurrently. Returns JSON with per-platform results (status available/taken/error with a 0-1 confidence score) and an available/taken summary. Narrower than namesniper_check when domains are not needed; if a wanted handle is taken, offer namesniper_watch. Free and rate-limited without an API key (Instagram, TikTok, and X/Twitter return best-effort HTTP confidence); a paid key unlocks verified accuracy on those three.

platforms.description: Platforms to check (default: all supported platforms)

tools.name: namesniper_generate
tools.description: Generate new brand name ideas with AI from a business or project description, each enriched with a live .com availability check. Non-deterministic: repeated calls produce different names (identical requests are served from a 24-hour cache and flagged with cached: true). Typical latency 5-30 seconds. Returns JSON names[] with the name, an explanation, tags, a confidence score, and comAvailable. Requires an API key (paid plan) and counts against a daily generation quota. To riff on a name the user already has, use namesniper_alternatives instead (free, deterministic).

description.description: Business or project description to generate names for

style.description: Style: modern, classic, tech, creative, professional, playful, abstract, luxury, minimalist

tools.name: namesniper_trademark
tools.description: Screen a brand name for US trademark conflicts against the USPTO database with similarity analysis. Returns JSON with matching marks and a summary including an overall risk rating; with includeVariations, common spelling variations are screened too (slower, more lookups). A screening aid, not legal advice. Requires an API key (paid plan).

tools.name: namesniper_alternatives
tools.description: Generate variations of an existing brand name using deterministic prefix, suffix, compound, and wordplay patterns. Returns JSON alternatives[] each with the name, the pattern used, a description, and a 0-100 brandability score. Use this to riff on a name the user already has; use namesniper_generate for brand-new AI ideas from a description. Free, no API key needed.

tools.name: namesniper_watch
tools.description: Start monitoring a taken username so the user can claim it the moment it frees up or drops. Creates one watch per platform against the plan's slot limit (already-watched pairs are skipped); checks then run automatically on a plan-based schedule and alerts are delivered in-app, by email, and to any configured webhooks. Returns JSON with created watch ids and the skipped count. List watches with namesniper_watches; stop one with namesniper_unwatch. Requires a paid API key (Pro or Business).

platforms.description: Platforms to monitor (default: all supported platforms)

userId.description: Ignored — derived from your API key

tools.name: namesniper_watches
tools.description: List every handle the account is monitoring. Returns JSON watches[] with id, username, platform, watch status, last observed availability, last-checked and last-changed timestamps, and check count, plus slot usage {used, limit}. Use a watch id with namesniper_unwatch to stop monitoring it. Requires an API key.

userId.description: Ignored — derived from your API key

tools.name: namesniper_unwatch
tools.description: Stop monitoring a watched handle and free its slot. Pass the watch id from namesniper_watches, or a username (optionally narrowed to one platform) to remove all its watches. Returns JSON with the removed count and ids. Requires an API key.

username.description: Remove watches for this username across all platforms unless platform is given

platform.description: Limit username-based removal to one platform

userId.description: Ignored — derived from your API key

tools.name: namesniper_telegram_price
tools.description: Look up the recorded market price history of a Telegram username: peak and latest on-chain sale (in TON), live auction state, and bid activity, from public TON blockchain records. Free, no API key needed.

username.description: The Telegram username to look up (without @)

tools.name: namesniper_roblox_rarity
tools.description: Rate the rarity of a Roblox username (Common to Legendary, 0-100 score) from measured namespace saturation data and name structure, with a live availability check. Free, no API key needed.
